title: Vercel bill: docs-only pushes no longer build, the Sentry upload stops writing 10,000 billed log lines per build, previews are untraced, and the PWA files skip the proxy

source.ref: Vercel billing export read 2026-10-05 (FOCUS charges, 28 of September's 30 days): $702 total, Build CPU Minutes $265, Observability Events $234, CDN Requests $59, Fast Origin Transfer $53

detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 from the Vercel billing export and the project's runtime and build logs, after the owner's "we have GOT to change that observability thing". The two big lines move TOGETHER with the build count, not with members: 2026-09-19 billed $33.57 of build and $18.11 of observability on a day of many merges; 2026-09-12, 2026-09-26, 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03, days with no build, billed under $0.10 of each. Production runtime logs are about 3,500 lines a day and 3,400 of them are the crons. One preview build wrote about 10,000 build log lines, nearly all the Sentry plugin listing each uploaded .js.map (silent was off because CI is set on Vercel). Preview deployments carried 15x the runtime log lines of production in the same 24 hours (e2e, visual and Lighthouse runs), each of them also a traced Sentry session, and /sw.js plus /offline.html alone were about 2,800 proxy invocations a day. Six threads merging in parallel produced 57 deployments on 2026-10-05 before 17:00 UTC, ledger fragments and ADRs included.

CLOSED 2026-10-05 (ADR-1704): (1) vercel.json ignoreCommand runs scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs, which skips a build only when every file changed since the branch's last successful deployment is documentation (docs/**, *.md, .claude/**, planning-docs.txt, LICENSE) and builds on any doubt; (2) next.config.ts makes the Sentry upload silent, turns its telemetry off and uploads source maps for production builds only; (3) lib/observability/sentry.ts samples zero traces on a preview deployment (errors still report); (4) proxy.ts's matcher excludes sw.js, offline.html and manifest.json. OWNER STEPS (dashboard, not repo) are in the thread reply: Observability Plus off or its retention down, the OTLP trace drain sampling for previews, build machine fixed at Standard, on-demand concurrent builds off, Skew Protection reviewed.

EXPECTED LIFT: the build line falls with the share of pushes that are docs-only (every ledger, ADR and doc PR, roughly a third of the day's deployments) and with the shorter upload; the observability line falls by the build-log share and the preview trace and proxy share. Together $150 to $250 a month at September's pace, with the dashboard steps on top. The owner's own 24-hour billing read after this deploys is the real number.

verify.cmd: node scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs --probe && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const n=fs.readFileSync("next.config.ts","utf8");const s=fs.readFileSync("lib/observability/sentry.ts","utf8");const p=fs.readFileSync("proxy.ts","utf8");const bad=[];if(!/silent:\s*true/.test(n))bad.push("the Sentry upload is not silent, so every build writes thousands of billed log lines");if(!/sourcemaps:\s*\{[^}]*disable:\s*!isProductionBuild/s.test(n))bad.push("source maps upload on previews too");if(!/VERCEL_ENV === .preview.\) return 0/.test(s))bad.push("preview deployments still sample traces");if(!/sw\\\\.js\$\|offline\\\\.html\$\|manifest\\\\.json\$/.test(p))bad.push("the proxy still runs on sw.js, offline.html and manifest.json");if(bad.length){console.error("HYG-162: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change (no ignoreCommand, a loud upload, traced previews, the proxy on the PWA files); passes with it. Measures the four repo-side consequences; the billing line itself is the owner's read.
